content.text:
I've taken the "anchor button" to be the Chain tab, the link icon between Code and Spec, since your instruction still doesn't name it. It now has no bottom border. All 218 tests pass (1 ignored), the build has no warnings, and `piton check`, `piton build check` and `piton build` pass. I haven't looked at it in the app.

**The cause:** Chain's own bottom border was already hidden, but the tab row drew one line across its full width. Chain is see-through, so whenever Code, Spec or Ask was selected, that row line showed along Chain's bottom edge. When Chain itself was selected there was no line, which is why it came and went.

**The fix** (`src/chat_input.rs`): each tab already draws its own bottom line, so the full-width row line was only needed under Chain and under the help text on the right. I removed it and gave the help-text area its own bottom line. The line still runs under every other tab and under the help text, but nothing is drawn under Chain in any selection.

**Spec:** the Chain section of the Chat Input scope now says Chain never has a line along its bottom, selected or not.

**Test:** `the_chain_has_no_bottom_line` selects each tab in turn and checks there's no visible line under Chain while the help text keeps its line. With the old row line put back, it fails, so it guards this exact problem.

If you meant a different button, tell me which one and I'll move the fix there.
